set.body:
Delivered: RepetitionDesign.withinParticipant creates directed same-participant across-occasion matched/control designs using existing PairDesign and keyed finite selection. RepetitionResult retains analyses and typed contrasts. The pinned phase-cosine case and compiled saved exhaustive two-phase guide are bounded evidence; eyesim groups across participant/stimulus unless separately stratified. Generic Trials codecs are already delivered.

Residual A, method breadth: reuse eyesim-compare's explicit dispatch/classification for pearson, spearman, fisherz, cosine, l1, jaccard, dcov and the intentional exact-EMD divergence. Pin repetitive_similarity pairwise true/false and multiscale mean/none. Audit the actual nested reference averaging: mean per comparison over available scales, then mean over comparisons; test heterogeneous scale failures so this cannot be confused with pooled scale averaging. Retain pair direction, self exclusions, participant/stimulus/occasion keys, duplicate/singleton/empty cases and selected/successful/contributing denominators.

Residual B, persistence: define a finite serializable vocabulary/registration for all-occasion projections, relations and Selection.BottomK controls, with schema/method/key identities. Do not serialize arbitrary Scala closures or string maps. A fresh registry reconstructs the same directed endpoints, candidate eligibility, seed/cap, exact selected keys and provenance as direct composition for at least three occasions, custom typed keys and missing/duplicate cases. Invalid projections/schemas are typed failures. Pin old v1 readability; incompatible wire meaning requires a new schema version.

Closure requires both residuals with independent Cartesian-pair/denominator oracles, exact save/reopen/rerun proof and JVM/JS conformance. eyesim-compare and eyesim-sampling are completion prerequisites; persistence scaffolding can start before their scientific qualification. Existing cosine evidence and generic Trials serialization do not close arbitrary design persistence.
Evidence gate: use the revision and backend locks in tools/r-parity/baseline.json and r-lock.json; new inputs/manifests are per-ticket, never edits to frozen baseline-cases.json. Record actual exported reference calls, independent analytic expectations, named numerical tolerances and exact identities. Normal workflows/tests require no R; R is an offline fixture oracle only. Exercise public JVM/Scala.js routes, typed failures and declared divergences; keep every failed/missing case. A function name or internal unit test is not cross-library conformance. New published laws require killed mutants. Update case evidence and PARITY.md only after measurement. See docs/TRACKER_REVIEW_2026-09-19.md for shared ownership and closure ordering.
set.title: Complete repetition method breadth and arbitrary-design persistence
